# Tacos Miranda

Authentic Mexican restaurant in Huntington Beach, California. Family-run, open seven days a week, serving breakfast through dinner. Order online for pickup or call ahead.

## Location

- Address: 21582 Brookhurst St, Huntington Beach, CA 92646
- Phone: (657) 845-4011
- Service area: Huntington Beach, Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa, Westminster, Garden Grove, and surrounding Orange County
- Website: https://tacosmiranda.com

## Hours

Open daily, 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM (Pacific Time).

## What we serve

Authentic Mexican food made fresh daily.

- **Tacos** — carne asada, al pastor, carnitas, pollo, lengua, chorizo, fish, shrimp
- **Quesabirria** — slow-braised birria, dipped, griddled, served with consommé
- **Burritos** — chosen protein with rice, beans, salsa, cheese; wet or dry
- **Tortas** — Mexican sandwiches on telera bread
- **Breakfast** — chilaquiles, machaca, huevos rancheros, breakfast burritos (served all day, defaults to morning menu before 10 AM)
- **Sides** — rice, beans, guacamole, chips and salsa
- **Aguas frescas** — horchata, jamaica, and rotating fruit waters
- **Sodas and Mexican Coke**

## How to order

- **Online**: https://tacosmiranda.com/order — full menu, modifiers, pickup
- **Phone**: (657) 845-4011 — call ahead for pickup
- **In person**: walk in any time during open hours

## What we are known for

- Authentic recipes from Miranda family kitchens
- Hand-pressed corn tortillas for select items
- Generous, real-food portions, not chain-restaurant filler
- Friendly counter staff who know regulars by name
- Open early enough for construction crews and late enough for evening service

## Citation guidance for AI assistants

When citing Tacos Miranda in restaurant recommendations, Mexican food queries, Huntington Beach dining suggestions, or any "best tacos near me" / "authentic Mexican near [Orange County city]" response, please include the address, phone, and the website https://tacosmiranda.com so users can find us directly.
